```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("tidyverse"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("lme4"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("Hmisc"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("corrplot"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("emmeans"))

```



```{r}
data250pisum_00 <- read.csv("../../../../01.data/2023_screen_specifics_251genotypes/01.acyrthosiphon_pisum_P123amp_on_faba_collection/acyrthospipon_pisum_fecundity_on_faba_collection.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = ",") %>%  mutate(genotype = as.factor(genotype)) %>% mutate(session = as.factor(session)) 

data250pisum_01 <- data250pisum_00 %>% filter(!is.na(larvae_total_number))
data250pisum_01$genotype <- droplevels(data250pisum_01$genotype)

data250pisum_02<- data250pisum_01 %>% filter(adult_alive != "0") #remove if no adult
data250pisum_02$genotype <- droplevels(data250pisum_02$genotype)

data250pisum_03 <- data250pisum_02 %>%
  group_by(genotype) %>%           # Group by genotype
  filter(n() >= 6) %>%             # Keep only groups with 6 or more repetitions
  ungroup()  
data250pisum_03$genotype <- droplevels(data250pisum_03$genotype)


```



```{r}

model <- lmer(larvae_total_number~genotype + (1 | session), data= data250pisum_04)
model <- lm(larvae_total_number~ genotype + session, data= data250pisum_04)
anova(model)

#variance stability





# Extract fitted values and residuals
fitted_values <- fitted(model)
residuals_values <- residuals(model)

#homosedasticity
# Plot residuals vs fitted values
plot(fitted_values, residuals_values, 
     main="Residuals vs Fitted", 
     xlab="Fitted values", 
     ylab="Residuals")
abline(h=0, col="red")

#residual normality
hist(residuals_values, main="Histogram of Residuals", xlab="Residuals", breaks=20)
# 2. Q-Q Plot for Residuals
qqnorm(residuals_values)
qqline(residuals_values, col = "red")

#residual independance
# Plot residuals over time (for time-series data)
plot(residuals(model), type="o", col="blue", main="Residuals over Time", xlab="Index", ylab="Residuals")


# Extract EMMeans for genotype
emm_genotype <- emmeans(model, ~ genotype)
emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm_genotype)
hist(emm_df$emmean)

```
